personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, strictly functional interface designed for maximum outdoor legibility and absolute simplicity for rural commuters.

spacing.rule: Use generous padding for outdoor legibility. Touch targets must be at least 56px, preferably 64px for primary actions.

dont's: Strictly DO NOT use glass/blur effects. The target devices are low-end Androids in rural areas, and outdoor visibility requires solid, opaque surfaces.

screens.name: Map (Home)
screens.purpose: Interactive map with live bus tracking, search, and immediate SOS access.

states.loading: Map skeleton with centered loading spinner.
states.empty: No nearby buses found - 'Search for a route' prompt.
states.error: Offline Reconnecting banner across the top.

screens.layout: Full-screen map view as the root canvas. Floating search bar at the top (safe area) containing 'Search Route' and a quick EN/HI language toggle. A floating red SOS FAB (error color) anchored to the bottom right. A persistent bottom sheet (solid surfaceSecondary) displaying the nearest stop ETA and the Catchability Index (Walk/Run/Wait).

screens.name: Routes
screens.purpose: Searchable list of all active routes and schedules.

states.empty: Illustration of a bus with 'No routes found. Try another search.'
states.error: Failed to load routes. Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header with search input. Vertical scroll list of route cards. Each card must have a massive touch target (min 64px height) displaying Route Number, Origin-Destination, and a chevron.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage accessibility, language, and admin login access.
screens.layout: List-based layout. Toggles for Audio Announcements (speaker icon) and Language (English/Hindi). A distinct, muted bottom link for 'Admin Access' (secure authentication entry).

screens.name: Admin Dashboard (Hidden/Secured)
screens.purpose: Monitor live bus movements, analytics, and manage routes.
screens.layout: Data-dense utility layout. Route replay slider, bunching warnings list, and demand heatmap toggle. Kept structurally clean without heavy graphics.

instructions_to_main_agent: PREMIUM REQUIREMENT: Ensure extreme high-contrast for outdoor visibility. Use stark black text (#050505) on white backgrounds (#FFFFFF). Avoid all blues, purples, or low-contrast pastels.
No Blur/Glassmorphism: Target devices are likely low-end Androids. Use solid backgrounds (e.g., surfaceSecondary) with standard elevation shadows instead of expo-blur.

Catchability Index Rule: Never rely on color alone. Pair the color-coded verdict with text and icons (e.g., Green 🚶 Walk, Yellow 🏃 Run, Red ✋ Wait). Ensure the yellow (warning) is darkened to #B87503 to maintain a 3:1 contrast ratio on white.
Touch Targets: Increase minimum touch targets to 56px-64px. Rural users may not be familiar with precise tapping; larger hit areas reduce friction.
Offline State: Build a graceful 'Reconnecting...' banner using the surfaceInverse token that drops down at the top of the screen when offline.
SOS Feature: The SOS panic button must use the 'error' color token (#D32F2F) and be prominent (FAB on the Map screen). Wire it to a heavy haptic feedback.
Audio & Language: Build explicit, large toggles for EN/HI language switching and Native Audio Announcements in the settings and/or floating search bar.
Images: Use the provided map_placeholder for the map view if a native map component isn't immediately configured, and ensure text overlays have a proper vertical gradient scrim if placed over images.
Do not display 'made with emergent' anywhere in the application.
